narrative: Demand for PL1__M203A428 is smooth and continuous (CV=0.396, 100% non-zero days) with a statistically significant upward trend (Kendall p=0.010), making a normal-distribution EOQ-based (r,Q) policy the appropriate choice. Lead times are moderately variable (CV=0.337) after removing one extreme data-entry error (9201.55 days). The recommended safety stock of 2,248 units — nearly 2.6x the current SAP level of 879 — is required to meet the 95% service level given joint demand and lead-time uncertainty. Consolidating from ~150 annual orders at MOQ to ~24 EOQ-sized orders yields a 62.8% total cost reduction while remaining within storage capacity.
